hook_line: WORLD CHAMPION GUKESH NAMED TO TIME100 NEXT INDIA

hook_stat.sub: World chess champion Gukesh Dommaraju is 20 years old

news_summary: World chess champion Gukesh Dommaraju, 20, is named in the Phenoms category of TIME100 Next India, TIME's first international edition of its rising-leaders list, released on Thursday.
payoff: Later this month he defends the world title for the first time, against Uzbekistan's Javokhir Sindarov.
